incident_spec.summary: Unpredictable single insert performance due to blocking and excessive indexing.
symptoms: Single insert operations occasionally take several minutes.
Blocking sessions appear in `sys.dm_exec_requests` but the blocking session ID does not correspond to an active query.
incident_spec.mechanism: Excessive indexing combined with blocking due to uncommitted transactions or lock contention.
